title: HP Hampden X3027 - plaque
memorial_details:
description: Plaque: IN MEMORY OF THE CREW/ OF/ HANDLEY PAGE HAMPDEN X3027/ (EA-A) 49 SQN. R.A.F./ (Names)/ WHO TRAGICALLY LOST THEIR LIVES IN THE/ SEA OFF SKEGNESS IN THE EARLY HOURS OF/ 
MONDAY 28 OCTOBER 1940

Information sheet: PROPELLER/ FROM HANDLEY PAGE HAMPDEN X3027/ IN THE EARLY HOURS OF 28TH OCTOBER 1940, HAMPDEN X3027, CODED EA-A OF 49/ SQUADRON WAS RETURNING TO RAF SCAMPTON, AFTER TAKING PART IN A RAID ON/ HAMBURG WITH 15 OTHER HAMPDENS. THE CREW WERE NO DOUBT LOOKING FORWARD/ TO A WELL EARNED REST AFTER DE-BRIEFING./ 
AT THE SAME TIME, LIEUTENANT VOLKER OF THE LUFTWAFFE, WAS PILOTING HIS/ JUNKERS 88 NIGHT FIGHTER OF Nr.1 GRUPPE, Nr. 3 NACHTJAGDGESCHWADER BETWEEN/ THE COAST AND THE LINCOLNSHIRE AIRFIELDS IN THE HOPE OF INTERCEPTING/ RETURNING BOMBERS./ 
VOLKER'S Ju88 AND x3027 MET SOMEWHERE IN THE DARKNESS OVER LINCOLNSHIRE. AS A/ RESULT OF THIS ENCOUNTER, X3027 CRASHED INTO THE SEA OFF SKEGNESS, WITH THE/ LOSS OF THE FOUR CREW/ CREW OF X3027/ (Names)
